definition.def: Artificial objects, materials, or processes do not occur naturally and are created by human beings, for example using science or technology.
examples: ...a wholefood diet free from artificial additives, colours and flavours.
The city is dotted with small lakes, natural and artificial.
He did not want his life to be prolonged by artificial means.

definition.def: An artificial state or situation exists only because someone has created it, and therefore often seems unnatural or unnecessary.
examples: Even in the artificial environment of an office, our body rhythms continue to affect us.
Removed from the artificial atmosphere of the fashion show, high-fashion clothes often look cheap and silly.

definition.def: If you describe someone or their behaviour as artificial, you disapprove of them because they pretend to have attitudes and feelings which they do not really have. [disapproval]
examples: The voice was patronizing and affected, the accent artificial.

definition.def: If you say that food tastes or looks artificial, you do not like it because its taste or appearance does not seem genuine, and seems to be created by added substances.
examples: The meat was chewy and the sauce was glutinous and tasted artificial.
...complaints that their tinned peas were an artificial shade of green.

examples.sentence: A major drawback of vertical farming, however, is that the plants would require artificial light.
Single-storey greenhouses have the benefit of natural overhead light: even so, many still need artificial lighting.
Classical music by an artificial composer has had audiences enraptured, and even tricked them into believing a human was behind the score.
The two men made a photographic excursion to Niagara Falls in 1860 and they cooperated on experiments with magnesium flares as a source of artificial light in 1865.
Automation - or 'embodied artificial intelligence' (AI) - is one aspect of the disruptive effects of technology on the labour market.
Artificial intelligence (AI) can already predict the future.
By mid-century, we may have artificial general intelligence (AGI) - machines that can achieve human-level performance on the full range of tasks that we ourselves can tackle.
Leonardo designed extensive hydraulic plants to create artificial canals throughout the city.
Noise, Alex Waibel tells me, is one of the major challenges that artificial speech translation has to meet.
The idea of artificial speech translation has been around for a long time.
